issues.description: Resource IDs are interpolated into URL paths without percent-encoding, so '/', '?', and '#' corrupt requests.
Transport errors and timeouts are not retried or wrapped, leaking raw httpx exceptions from the SDK.
Retry-After parsing only accepts numeric seconds and ignores valid HTTP-date retry headers.
Client configuration validation is incomplete, allowing empty API keys and invalid backoff values.
Negative or inconsistent backoff settings can produce invalid sleep durations at runtime.
Pagination response shape is not validated, so malformed success bodies can silently yield no items.
Batch responses are not validated for result count, unique indexes, or complete coverage of input tasks.
BatchItemResult does not validate status values or created/error field invariants.
ReviewResult does not validate verdict values despite exposing a restricted Verdict type.
Mock batch endpoint can crash on malformed JSON shapes instead of returning a 400 contract error.
Mock review endpoint assumes a JSON object and can crash on valid JSON with the wrong shape.
Test code dereferences an optional task without narrowing, causing a mypy union-attr failure.
Generator fixture is annotated as returning LumenClient instead of Generator, causing a mypy failure.
